title: Claims list
body:
### Summary

Claimants see their claims and each claim's status in one list, with an empty state when they have none.

### Problem

Claimants cannot see what happened to a claim they submitted; support logged 140 tickets in September 2026 asking where a claim went.

### Scope

In scope: the list of a claimant's own claims with status, and the empty state. Out of scope: editing claims from the list.

### Expected paths

internal/claims/**
web/src/claims/**
